title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
title_hi: राजर्षि छत्रपति शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क छात्रवृत्ति योजना
title_mr: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना (ईबीसी)
ministry: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_audience: Economically Weaker and Open/OBC Higher Education Students
description: Financial assistance providing 50% tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement to students admitted under higher education professional/non-professional degree and diploma courses in Maharashtra.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र में उच्च शिक्षा व्यावसायिक और गैर-व्यावसायिक डिग्री एवं डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रमों में प्रवेश लेने वाले छात्रों को 50% शिक्षण शुल्क और परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति प्रदान करने वाली योजना।
description_mr: महाराष्ट्रात उच्च आणि तंत्रशिक्षण, पदविका आणि पदवी अभ्यासक्रमांसाठी प्रवेश घेतलेल्या आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल घटकातील विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी ५०% शिक्षण शुल्क आणि परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ती योजना.
benefits_summary: 50% tuition fee and 50% exam fee reimbursement transferred directly to verified bank account (DBT).

rules.failure_reason: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
Applicant must currently be an enrolled student in an accredited college or polytechnic.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 8,00,000.

required_documents.description: Tahasildar issued income certificate for current financial year
College / Polytechnic Bonafide or Student ID card

title: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (MahaDBT)
title_hi: ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना
title_mr: इतर मागासवर्गीय (OBC) विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना
ministry: OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra
department: Directorate of Other Backward Bahujan Kalyan
target_audience: OBC Students pursuing Diploma, Degree, or Post-Graduate studies
description: Comprehensive scholarship covering 100% tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance for eligible Other Backward Class students across Maharashtra colleges.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के कॉलेजों में पात्र अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग के छात्रों के लिए 100% शिक्षण शुल्क, परीक्षा शुल्क और निर्वाह भत्ता कवर करने वाली छात्रवृत्ति।
description_mr: महाराष्ट्र राज्यातील इतर मागासवर्गीय (ओबीसी) विद्यार्थ्यांच्या उच्च शिक्षणासाठी १००% शिक्षण शुल्क, परीक्षा शुल्क आणि विद्यावेतन देणारी योजना.
benefits_summary: 100% tuition and exam fee waiver + monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 1,200.

rules.failure_reason: Applicant must belong to recognized OBC/VJNT/SBC category.
Family annual income must not exceed Rs 3,00,000 for this quota.

required_documents.description: Income certificate issued by competent authority
College ID or Admission Confirmation Receipt

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
title_mr: मुख्यमंत्री युवा कार्य प्रशिक्षण योजना (लाडका भाऊ योजना)
ministry: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Maharashtra
department: Directorate of Vocational Education and Training
target_audience: Youth aged 18 to 35 seeking 6-month on-the-job industrial apprenticeship
description: State internship initiative providing monthly stipends up to Rs 10,000 to 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, and Graduate youth during industrial training with accredited private and public sector enterprises.
description_hi: 12वीं पास, आईटीआई, डिप्लोमा और स्नातक युवाओं को औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षण के दौरान 10,000 रुपये तक मासिक वजीफा प्रदान करने वाली इंटर्नशिप योजना।
description_mr: महाराष्ट्रातील १२ वी उत्तीर्ण, आयटीआय, पदविका (डिप्लोमा) आणि पदवीधर युवकांना औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षणादरम्यान दरमहा ६,००० ते १०,००० रुपये विद्यावेतन देणारी योजना.
benefits_summary: Monthly government stipend: Rs 6,000 (12th pass), Rs 8,000 (Diploma/ITI), Rs 10,000 (Degree/PG) for 6 months.

rules.failure_reason: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must be 35 years or younger.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
target_audience: Small and Marginal Landholder Farmer Families
description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments directly to bank accounts of landholding farmers.
description_hi: भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों के बैंक खातों में प्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये की आय सहायता तीन समान किस्तों में प्रदान करने वाली केंद्रीय योजना।
description_mr: देशातील सर्व जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंबांना दरवर्षी ६,००० रुपये थेट बँक खात्यात तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये आर्थिक सहाय्य देणारी केंद्र शासनाची योजना.
benefits_summary: Direct financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year credited in three installments of Rs 2,000 each.

rules.failure_reason: Applicant or family must be engaged in cultivation on cultivable land.
Applicant primary occupation must be agriculture.

required_documents.description: 7/12 Land Record document proving cultivable land ownership
Aadhaar Card linked with active NPCI bank account

title: Stand-Up India Scheme for Greenfield Enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
target_audience: SC, ST, and Women Entrepreneurs setting up new greenfield enterprises
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 Lakhs and Rs 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield manufacturing, services, or trading enterprises.
description_hi: हर बैंक शाखा से कम से कम एक एससी/एसटी और एक महिला उद्यमी को विनिर्माण, सेवा या व्यापार में नए उद्यम स्थापित करने के लिए 10 लाख से 1 करोड़ रुपये तक का ऋण।
description_mr: नवीन उत्पादन, सेवा किंवा व्यापार उद्योग सुरू करण्यासाठी अनुसूचित जाती, जमाती किंवा महिला उद्योजकांना १० लाख ते १ कोटी रुपयांपर्यंतचे बँक कर्ज मिळवून देणारी योजना.
benefits_summary: Collateral-facilitated bank loans from Rs 10 Lakhs to Rs 1 Crore with composite credit and margin support.

rules.failure_reason: Applicant must be an active entrepreneur establishing a greenfield business.
Enterprise must have at least 51% shareholding held by SC, ST, or Woman entrepreneur.

required_documents.description: Detailed business project report and machinery quotation
PAN card and enterprise registration / Udyam Certificate

title: [DEMO] Chief Minister Higher Fellowship Program
target_audience: Experienced Professionals and Post-Graduates aged 25 to 30
description: A prestigious 1-year governance fellowship placed directly with District Collectors and State Administrative Departments.
description_hi: जिला कलेक्टरों और प्रशासनिक विभागों के साथ सीधे तौर पर 1 वर्ष की प्रतिष्ठित शासन फेलोशिप।
description_mr: जिल्हाधिकारी व शासकीय विभागांसोबत धोरण व विकासात्मक कामांसाठी १ वर्षाची विशेष फेलोशिप.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of Rs 75,000 + Rs 5,000 travel allowance.

rules.failure_reason: Applicant must be at least 25 years old to qualify for this fellowship.
Applicant cannot exceed 30 years of age.

required_documents.description: Post-Graduate or First Class Degree Certificate
